recentItems.title: How to Implement the 'Forever Paycheck' Into Retirement Savings
recentItems.description:

She explains what the "forever paycheck" is and details the process for implementing it into your finances.

recentItems.title: Laila Ali Talks Debut Children's Book, 'A Spark of Greatness'
recentItems.description:
Undefeated boxing champion Laila Ali stops by TODAY to talk about her debut picture book “A Spark of Greatness.” She talks about her upbringing and relationship with her father Muhammad Ali, and how he inspired the project. “I like to live by example, just as my father did for me…this [book] actually is part of a larger initiative. I really want to inspire kids to create a strong foundation.” Laila also shares that the Children’s Miracle Network will be providing 4,000 copies of her book to children’s hospitals.
